named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.acctPath
named-native-query.query: SELECT ep_path FROM esq_entity_path WHERE ep_pk = CAST(:parentId AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.insertAcctPath
named-native-query.query: INSERT INTO esq_entity_path (ep_pk, ep_et_pk, ep_path) VALUES (CAST(:pk AS bigint), :kind, :path)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.insertAcct
named-native-query.query: INSERT INTO esq_account (acc_pk, acc_et_pk, acc_id, acc_desc, acc_ccy, acc_status, acct_neg_allowed_flg, acc_usr_pk, acc_crl_id, acc_req_id, acc_uid) VALUES (CAST(:id AS bigint), :kind, :name, :desc, :ccy, :status, :negativeAllowed, CAST(:parentId AS bigint), :correlationId, :requestId, :uid)
